content: अपहारः .²1 Taking or carrying away, stealing, plundering, removing, killing, destroying; कर्णनासापहारेण भगिनी मे विरूपिता <ls>Rām.</ls> by the cutting of ears and nose; निद्रापहार, विष˚. .²2 Concealing, dissembling; कथमात्मापहारं करोमि <ls>Ś. 1</ls> how shall I dissemble myself, conceal my real name and character; see अपहारक below. .²3 Spending or using anotherʼs property. .²4 Loss, damage. .²5 Bringing in, obtaining; समित्कुशकुसुमापहारसंमार्जनलब्धविश्रमाः (वानप्रस्थाः) <ls>Mb. 12. 192. 1</ls>.
